programme: Diploma in Labour Laws and Labour Welfare (D.L.L. & L.W.)

subjects.title: Law Relating to Industrial Relations and Disputes

units.title: Industrial Disputes Act, 1947
units.topics: Definitions: Industry, Workmen, Employers, Industrial Disputes etc., Scope of Industry. Authorities for the settlement of disputes, 1947, methods of settlement, Procedure, Power and Duties of Authorities. Strike, Lock Out, Lay-Off, Retrenchment and Closure. Penalties, Offences by Companies etc.

units.title: The Trade Union Act, 1926
units.topics: Collective Bargaining - Concept and Process, Legal control, Factor affecting collective bargaining, Merits and Demerits of collective bargaining. History and Development of Trade Union Movement with reference to India. Registration of Trade Union, Rights and Liabilities of Registered Trade Union, Penalties and procedure

units.title: Industrial Employment (Standing Order) Act, 1946
units.topics: Definition, Historical Background, Application of the Act, Model Standing Orders - Misconducts. Submission of drafts standing orders, conditions for standing orders, certification of standing order, Posting, Duration and modification of standing orders. Disciplinary Proceedings in Industries/Domestic Inquiry - Preliminary Enquiry, Charge-sheet, Procedure of Domestic Inquiry. Powers of Certifying officers and appellate authority. Penalties and procedure

units.title: Maharashtra Recognition of Trade Union and Prevention of Unfair Labour Practice Act, 1971
units.topics: Authorities. Powers and Duties. Recognition of Union, Rights of recognized union, other unions and certain employees. Illegal strikes and lockouts. Unfair Labour Practices. Penalties and Procedure

units.title: The Payment of Wages Act, 1936
units.topics: Definitions, Object, Historical background. Responsibility for payment of wages, Obligations of employer and employee. Authorised deductions of wages. Enforcement machinery under the Act & their powers and functions. Offences and Penalties.

units.title: The Minimum Wages Act, 1948
units.topics: Definitions, Objectives, Theories of Wages. Fixation & Revision of rates of Wages, Working Hours and Determination of Wages and Claim etc. Authorities, Powers & Duties of the Authority. Offences and Penalties.

units.title: The Payment of Bonus Act, 1965
units.topics: Historical Background, Aims and Objectives of the Act. Concept of Bonus - Meaning and Definition. Computation of Gross Profits, available surplus and allocable surplus. Eligibility & Disqualification for bonus. Minimum & Maximum bonus, set on and set off. Inspectors - Powers and Duties. Offences and Penalties.

units.title: The Equal Remuneration Act, 1976
units.topics: Definitions, Aims and Objectives. Duty of employer to pay equal remuneration to men and women workers for same work or work of a similar nature. Discrimination not to be made while recruiting men and women workers. Authorities - Advisory Committee, Inspectors, their powers and duties. Offences and Penalties.

units.title: Social Security
units.topics: Importance of social security. Conceptual frame work of Social Security, Evolution of Social Security system in India

units.title: Employee’s Compensation Act, 1923
units.topics: Definitions, Aims & Objectives. Liability of Employer, Defences. Notional Extension, Cases. Determination of Amount of Compensation, Compensation when due-Penalty for default, Contracting Out. Labour Commissioner - Duties and Powers

units.title: Employee’s State Insurance Act 1948
units.topics: Employees State Insurance Fund, Employer and Employees Contributions, Grant by the Central Government etc. Benefits under the Act, Adjudication of Disputes & Claims- E.I. Court. Penalties and Procedure

units.title: Employee’s Provident Fund Act, 1952
units.topics: Aim & Objective, Definitions. Scheme: Employees Provident Fund Scheme, Employees Pension Scheme, Insurance Scheme. Determination of Money Due from Employers, Mode of Recovery. Penalties and Procedure

units.title: The Maternity Benefit Act, 1961
units.topics: Definitions, Aims and Objectives. Right to payment of Maternity Benefit, Notice of Claim for Maternity Benefit, Dismissal during absence of pregnancy. Powers and Duties of Inspectors. Penalties and Procedure

units.title: Bombay Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1953
units.topics: Definitions. Constitution of Board, Vesting and Application of Fund. Appointment and Powers of Welfare Commissioner. Penalties and Procedure

units.title: The Payment of Gratuity Act 1972
units.topics: Object & Scope of the Act, Concept of Gratuity. Continuous Service, Continuous Service for one year. Payment of Gratuity, Forfeiture of Gratuity, Determination of amount of Gratuity. Recovery of Gratuity, Protection of Gratuity. Controlling Authorities and their Powers. Penalties and Offences

units.title: The Factories Act, 1948
units.topics: Definition of factory, Manufacturing process, Worker, Occupier. Health, welfare and safety provisions under the Act. Employer’s liability- liability for hazardous and inherently dangerous industries. Role of Factory Inspector. Working Hours, Leave with wages etc.

units.title: The Plantation Labour Act, 1951
units.topics: Registration of Plantation. Inspecting staff- Powers and liability. Hours and Limitation of employment, leave with wages, accidents. Penalties and Procedure

units.title: The Dock Workers (Regulation of Employment) Act, 1948
units.topics: Establishment and constitution of first advisory committee. Inspectors - Power and duties. Penalties and Procedure

units.title: The Mines Act, 1952
units.topics: Definitions: Mine, Minerals, Owner, Agent, Manager. Health, Safety and Welfare provisions. Working Hours, Leave with wages etc. Inspectors - Power and duties. Penalties and Procedure

units.title: The Bombay Shop and Establishment Act, 1948
units.topics: Registration of establishments. Opening and Closing hours, Employment of children, young persons and women. Health and safety provisions. Enforcement, Inspection and Penalties

units.title: Contract Labour (Regulation and abolition) Act, 1970
units.topics: Aims & Objectives. Advisory Boards- Central and State, their powers and duties. Registration of establishments employing contract labour. Licensing of contractors. Welfare and health of contract labour. Penalties and Procedure

units.title: Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act, 1986
units.topics: Object & Scope of the Act. Prohibition of employment of children in certain occupations and processes. Regulation of conditions of work of children. Child Labour Technical Advisory Committee. Penalties and Procedure

subjects.title: Practical Training Paper: Field Work and Viva-Voce

units.title: Maintaining a Journal
units.topics: Every student will be required to keep a Journal of the Field work done during the course of his / her study. Article on Current Labour problems/ Labour Topic : One. Study of Labour Cases - Supreme Court or High Court : One. Summary of Seminar/Moot Court/Guest Lectures/Group Discussion/Work shop : Two. Study of different forms / Returns / to be filled under varies Labour Laws : One

units.title: Study Tour Reports (Field Work Visit)
units.topics: Visit to Factory/ Industry OR Visit to Labour Court/Industrial Court OR Visit to Government Office relating to Labour Department. Visit to any office of the Commissioner of Labour OR Any Office of Director, Safety and Health (Factory Inspector Office). Visit to Office of the Local Manager OR Employees State Insurance Corporation

units.title: Viva-Voce
units.topics: Viva-Voce (Oral) based on Journal and Field Work visits.
